summary.zh-CN: 从评测目标到案例设计，记录我们如何测试、如何判断，以及证据能说明什么。
summary.en: How we test Agent safety, design cases and interpret the evidence.

overviewSummary.zh-CN: 为什么要评测Agent安全？从电脑权限与用户风险出发，了解这项评测的目标、方法和阶段性发现。
overviewSummary.en: Why evaluate Agent safety? Start with computer permissions and user risks, then explore the evaluation goals, methods and findings.

summary.zh-CN: 从提示注入风险，到四个 Agent 的摄像头、麦克风、截图和录屏实测。查看具体提示词与实际录像。
summary.en: From prompt injection risks to camera, microphone, screenshot and screen recording tests with four Agents. See the prompts and recordings.

title.zh-CN: 为什么有些案例执行固定程序，有些直接给出任务？
title.en: When should a case use a fixed program or a direct task?

summary.zh-CN: 拆解两类案例的设计取舍：如何区分程序是否有效、Agent是否执行，以及保护措施是否生效。
summary.en: Separate program validity, Agent execution and protection outcomes, and explain what each case design can measure.

title.zh-CN: 点击允许之后，我们还要观察什么？
title.en: What should we observe after clicking Allow?

summary.zh-CN: 区分初始拦截、风险提示、授权决定与最终效果，说明为什么一次审批不能代表全部安全结论。
summary.en: Distinguish initial blocks, warnings, approval decisions and final effects, and explain why an approval alone cannot establish a safety result.

title.zh-CN: 保护了一个文件，就保护了它所在的目录吗？
title.en: Does protecting a file also protect its parent directory?

summary.zh-CN: 以文件访问和上级目录操作为线索，解释保护对象、操作路径与资源边界为什么需要分别验证。
summary.en: Use file access and parent-directory operations to explain why targets, operation paths and resource boundaries need separate checks.

title.zh-CN: 从一段录像到一个分数，中间需要哪些证据？
title.en: What evidence connects a recording to a score?

summary.zh-CN: 说明操作尝试、独立观察、提示截图与未评估状态如何组成一条可复核的证据链。
summary.en: Connect attempted operations, independent observations, warning captures and unassessed states into a result that readers can verify.
